sources.publication_check: PubMed and journal-layout copy inspected; inherited first-day issue-month placeholder is not verified. Final publisher version, exact date and correction/retraction checks outstanding.

sources.appraisal: Methods pp.1178–1179, Fig. 1, p.1182 Fig. 2 and discussion checked. Phase 2 n=56, biopsy n=55; recently trained, small age-by-dose cells, imputation; repeated strength testing even during detraining.

claims.assertion: The adjusted deadlift 1RM change contrast favored concentrated versus distributed conditioning in the six-week-per-condition crossover.
claims.limitations: Unmonitored background lifting; carryover, multiple outcomes, achieved dose uncertainty; not a controlled strength-versus-running emphasis comparison.
claims.assessment: Original model coefficient and SE extracted; exact interval and independent review outstanding.

support.result: Adjusted intervention beta +5.53 kg, SE 2.11 kg, p=0.018, d=0.85; exact model CI not extracted.
support.restriction: Study-specific conditioning allocation; no inference of maintenance equivalence, optimal phase order or approved hybrid transfer.

claims.assertion: The weekly and alternate-week groups showed different descriptive patterns of measured half-squat 1RM retention after preparatory training.
claims.limitations: Seven per arm; participant turnover/attrition; cumulative set dose differs; within-group significance pattern does not establish between-group effect or equivalence.
claims.assessment: Article-text copy checked; final version, adherence, direct contrast and independent review outstanding.

support.result: Weekly group no detected decline; alternate-week group half-squat 1RM declined 10 ± 4% (mean ± SE), p<0.05. Direct between-group change interval not extracted.
support.restriction: Specific half-squat protocol; not a universal weekly maintenance floor; no approved hybrid transfer.

claims.assertion: Mean myofiber area in the young reduced-dose groups remained above pretraining baseline through phase 2; the one-third group showed additional enlargement at the first phase-2 sampling. Exact retention of the entire acquired gain relative to end of development was not established by an equivalence comparison.
claims.limitations: Recently trained adults; biopsy endpoint; small age-by-dose samples; attrition and mean substitution; age-dependent responses. Verified significance comparison is against pretraining baseline; narrower scope proposed, subject to catalog validation.
claims.assessment: Article-text copy and figure inspected; matched end-development to final contrast and interval not extracted.

support.locator: Results p.1182; Fig. 2, mean myofiber area; Methods Fig. 1
support.result: Time × age × group interaction p<0.05; young groups remained above baseline at phase-2 sampling, p<0.05; one-third group additional enlargement in first 16 weeks of phase 2, p<0.05. Exact retention contrast CI unavailable.
support.restriction: Myofiber area, not measured whole-muscle retention or a universal one-ninth maintenance rule. No approved transfer.
